info.title: AwardHome Partner API
info.description: Dancer-award lookups for vetted partner organizations (e.g. schools verifying an applicant's competition record). Two endpoints, deliberately: exact-match disambiguation by dancer name + studio, then the detail record by the dancer's opaque unique_id. There is no browse, no prefix search, and no listing surface — the partner must already know who they are asking about. Every request requires a partner key issued by AwardHome after a signed data agreement, every lookup is audited, and per-key daily quotas apply. Data visibility matches the public dancer profile exactly: safety-suppressed dancers do not exist here, search honors family opt-outs, and each award carries its verification_status so provenance can be weighed.

partnerKey.description: Partner API key (apk_…), issued by AwardHome, sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>. Keys are server-to-server credentials; never ship one in client-side code.

DancerSummary.description: Enough to tell same-name dancers apart, deliberately not the full record.

is_claimed.description: 1 when a family manages this profile.

place_display.description: Human-readable placement, formatted by the same helper the public pages use.

verification_status.description: Provenance: e.g. unverified (scraped from official results), family_submitted, corroborated, studio_confirmed.

get.summary: Find dancers by exact name at a studio
get.description: Exact-match (case- and whitespace-folded) dancer name at the named studio. Studio names tolerate the spelling variance real paperwork contains (case, spacing, punctuation) but never resolve to more than one studio. Same-name dancers at one studio all come back; choose by summary and query the detail endpoint with the unique_id.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The dancer's full name, exactly as known.

200.description: Zero or more matches. studio_matched=false means the studio name resolved to nothing (and no dancer search ran).

429.description: Burst rate limit or daily quota exceeded.

get.summary: Full public award record for one dancer
get.description: Addressed by the opaque unique_id from the search step only — numeric ids are refused. Returns exactly what the dancer's public profile shows, structured: both solo and group awards, family-hidden cards excluded, newest season first.

429.description: Burst rate limit or daily quota exceeded.
